notes.title: Various bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for reporting all the bugs and sorry for the mistakes! Here is the update list:

Fix: cut off text
Fix: activating missing translation blocked
Fix: garbled text for the Game Over message
Fix: glitched out graphics for collision tiles
Fix: octopus boss failing to react to hits by harpoon
Fix: octopus boss HP instant depletion
Fix: game freezing if timer reaches 0
